title: Validate inquiry and quotation lineage in ordinary quotation and PI saves
description: Stage3 core business workflow integrity. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Add Application finite source-lineage validation to quotation and PI ordinary create/update/submit/approve: exact InquiryId or QuotationId, live enabled existing source/target menu and customer scope, authoritative source number/ancestry and existing source eligibility. Reject foreign/missing/deleted/cancelled/ineligible source and conflicting customer/link. Manual unlinked documents remain usable and caller free-text source number is not an authoritative link. Preserve established quote/PI editable commercial details, deposit/currency/unit/calculation and version rules; no fabricated snapshot overwrite.

Use existing InquiryMutationRules/QuotationMutationRules/ProformaInvoiceMutationRules locks and transactions before duplicate resolution or number reservation. Ordinary prefill save vs direct conversion and source invalidation are serialized under one documented order, enforcing existing one-target/version-specific conversion rules and retaining historical links on unavailable source. Permission/invalid-row/write failure rolls back target/source/details/audit/number evidence. Real SQL two independent connections ordinary/direct conversion, source cancel/save and concurrent linked saves plus forged/revoked/disabled/foreign denials; relevant unit existing conversion/revision/PI regressions and safe Release/full unit, browser evidence or accurate blocker.
